name: Cheesy Macaroni Bake with Turnips, Bread Crumbs & Honey-Lemon Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium turnips
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil.
While the water is heating, peel, trim, and medium dice turnips.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, then add salt, turnip, and pasta; stir for a few seconds. Cook until turnip is just tender and pasta reaches desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
425 g macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces. Coarsely grate cheddar. Place both in another large pot.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) block cream cheese
¾ (227 g) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add milk, Dijon, and spices to the pot with the cheese. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a simmer, stirring often. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is combined and thickened, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml whole milk
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and turnip are done, drain in a colander, and transfer to the pot with the sauce. Stir to combine, then transfer to a large baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Sprinkle bread crumbs over the cheesy macaroni. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until bread crumbs are golden, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the bowl with the dressing, then toss to coat.
To serve, divide cheesy macaroni and salad between plates. Enjoy!
